name: Clean Stylized Architectural Visualization
description: Technical clarity over photorealism; premium isometric architecture storytelling

LOCKED_THREE_QUARTER.note: Same view direction as the v0.1 camera (7.7, -9.9, 7.5) looking at (0, 0, 1.6); position and scale are fitted to geometry.

BRIDGE_THREE_QUARTER.note: M4: long structures along X; more frontal than LOCKED_THREE_QUARTER so the elevation (arches, truss web) reads.

ELEVATION.note: M4: side elevation (looking along +Y), for silhouette and proportion checks.

TOP.note: M4: plan view (near-vertical; exactly vertical is undefined for a level camera).

BRIDGE_STACK.note: M4: SIDE_BY_SIDE layout STACK (models stacked in depth, one row per model on screen).

CATHEDRAL_FROM_BELOW.note: Worm's-eye axonometric (Choisy's classic view of vaults) for close-ups of the vault: ribs and web read from below. The camera lies below the ground plane, which is hidden for these shots, with a flat backdrop.

CATHEDRAL_VAULT_BELOW.note: A steeper worm's-eye view than CATHEDRAL_FROM_BELOW: the two diagonal ribs of a bay read as an X, the web between them as a surface; the piers are foreshortened. g-r5: the church floor stays (a SEQUENCE may open above it, on the whole church, then fade it out and orbit under one bay); a shot that starts below must fade the floor out at once.

CATHEDRAL_TRANSVERSE.note: The cut face of the church, nearly square on: the classic transverse section that explains flying buttresses (vault, high wall, aisle, flyer and pier buttress in profile), with a little depth so the bays behind read. No ground plane: at 5 degrees it read as a hard grey band across the frame; the church floor stays.

CATHEDRAL_SECTION.note: A church section open at the front (near y = 0): low enough to read the arches, buttresses and the inner face of the far wall.

FLOAT_AERIAL.note: Floating family: the district from above at an angle, so the platform grid, the lagoon and the links to the quay read together.

FLOAT_THREE_QUARTER.note: Floating family: a low three-quarter view of platforms on the water (decks, gaps, walkways, the hull's side above the waterline).

FLOAT_SECTION.note: Floating family: the cut face at y = 0 square on (hull, compartments, water in section, the waterline). No environment ground: seen edge-on it would add a line at the waterline.

FLOAT_UNDERWATER.note: Floating family: a low three-quarter view for shots that ghost the water to show moorings and the seabed. No environment ground: it lies just below the water surface and would hide everything under it.

lighting.note: Sun lights so models anywhere are lit identically (SIDE_BY_SIDE). Key from front-left and high: front faces lit, right faces in shade, short shadows that do not reach a neighbouring model. Chosen 2026-10-26 from variants L0-L3 at 960x540.

materials.note: Highlight = self-coloured glow (no accent tint). Fading parts get blended-transparency twins shown only mid-fade; opaque frames use dithered materials.

covering_units.note: Stylised roofing units (M3.5 readability). course = rib gauge in engine/geometry.py COVERING_STYLES.

labels.note: SIDE_BY_SIDE captions (M3.5). size = text height as a fraction of frame height.
